resources.string: Taps “Force stop” in Settings for the apps you pick

Lets Force Stop drive the system Settings screen on your behalf. When you tap the button in the app, it opens “App info” for each app you selected and presses “Force stop”, then the confirmation. Android grants access to active-window content, which can include other apps. During a run, Force Stop checks each active root and ignores it unless it belongs to Settings before searching for or clicking controls. It ignores accessibility events and starts no automation unless you start a run.
